task.title: Cardio Product B: Dosage Instructions for 2 mg/kg IV Administration
task.shortdesc: Instruction for administering Cardio Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV.

prereq.p: Verify patient's weight and confirm eligibility for Cardio Product B treatment.

step.cmd: Calculate the total dose of Cardio Product B based on the patient's weight (2 mg/kg).
step.stepxmp: A 70 kg patient requires a total dose of 140 mg (70 kg × 2 mg/kg).

step.cmd: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection before administration.
step.stepresult: The IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.

step.cmd: Administer Cardio Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV over 10 minutes.
step.info: Monitor patient's vital signs and adjust dosage as necessary.

step.cmd: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection after administration.
step.stepresult: The IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.
